parameters.content:
# Test Email Sender

## Purpose
Sends test emails to your AI chatbot's inbox, one at a time with a delay between each, so you can exercise the chatbot end-to-end with a batch of test cases without manual sending. Each test case row becomes one email — `TEST ID` is the subject, `EMAIL BODY` is the body.

## How it works
- Reads test cases from a Google Sheet (your test definition sheet)
- *(Optional)* Filters down to a subset of tests via the **Filter From Test 71** node
- Loops over the remaining cases (Split In Batches)
- For each: sends an email to the chatbot's inbox (current target: `your-email@example.com`)
- Waits 2 minutes between sends so the chatbot has time to process each one and so Gmail's send-rate limits aren't tripped

## Triggered by
Manual trigger only — click `Run Tests` to send the batch.

## About the Filter From Test 71 node (OPTIONAL)

**This node is not required for the workflow to function.** It's a convenience filter for *resumability* — letting you skip test cases you've already sent and only send the remaining ones.

**Current condition**: keeps test cases where `TEST ID` starts with `TC` and the trailing number is ≥ 73. *(Despite the node name "Filter From Test 71", the actual threshold is 73 — the name is stale; rename the node if you change the threshold.)*

**When you'd want it**
- Resuming a partial batch (last successful send was TC72, restart from TC73)
- Testing a specific subset without re-running the whole batch
- Skipping known-broken tests temporarily

**When you'd remove it**
- First-time test run (send everything)
- Re-testing the full suite from scratch
- Your TEST ID format isn't `TC<NUMBER>` (the filter expression `Number($json['TEST ID'].substring(2))` assumes a 2-character prefix + number)

**To remove it**: delete the `Filter From Test 71` node and re-connect `Read Test Cases` → `Loop Over Items` directly.

**To adapt it**: edit the filter's condition expression to match your own logic — e.g. by category column, by a "skip" flag, by date range, by a different ID format.

## Reads / writes
- **Reads**: test case sheet (each row becomes one email)
- **Writes**: sends emails via Gmail; does NOT write to any sheet

## Configuration to update before reusing this workflow
- **`Send Test Email` node → `Send To`**: change the recipient to your AI chatbot's inbox address
- **Gmail credential** on `Send Test Email`: set to the account you want to send FROM (any inbox the chatbot accepts; doesn't have to match the receiver)
- **`Wait Between Emails`**: tune the 2-minute delay if your chatbot processes faster/slower, or if your Gmail account has stricter send-rate limits
- **`Read Test Cases`**: point to your own test sheet (current is hard-coded to a specific Google Sheets document ID)
